title: Mac OS X Aqua interface
lede: Apple’s water-themed interface: gel buttons, droplet controls, and reflective surfaces that set up the gloss of the later style.
summary: Gel buttons, translucent droplets, and a reflective Dock. Apple, 2000 onward.
made: Introduced January 2000; first released July 2000 with iMovie 2 and in Mac OS X 10.0 in 2001

evidence.note: Inspected two non-free screenshots in scratchpad copies: [File:Macosxpb.png](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Macosxpb.png) (Mac OS X Public Beta, 365 × 273) and [File:Leopard Desktop.png](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Leopard_Desktop.png) (Mac OS X Leopard, 800 × 500). Not stored.

styles.note: Aqua introduced the water-like, glossy, translucent controls that Frutiger Aero inherits; it is a precursor more than a full example.

context: Aqua “was themed to replicate water, with ‘droplet-like’ components and a heavy use of reflective effects and translucency.” It was introduced at Macworld in January 2000, first shipped with iMovie 2 in July 2000, and with Mac OS X 10.0 the following year. [Wikipedia: Aqua](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aqua_(user_interface)).
Before OS X Yosemite (2014), most Aqua controls had a “glass” or “gel” effect. Apple moved to flat design in 2013. [Wikipedia: Aqua](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aqua_(user_interface)).
CARI lists “Aqua” as an alternate name for Frutiger Aero. [CARI: Frutiger Aero](https://cari.institute/aesthetics/frutiger-aero).
observed: Public Beta (2000): windows have pinstriped gray bars, red, yellow, and green gel buttons, and translucent blue highlighted menu items.
Public Beta: the Dock at the bottom holds glossy, shaded icons on a translucent strip.
Leopard (2007): the desktop picture is a magenta and violet aurora with stars; the Dock is a reflective glass shelf with icons mirrored below.
Leopard: window chrome is gray and brushed rather than pinstriped; blue folder icons are soft and rounded.
interpretation: Aqua supplies the gloss, gel, and reflection. Frutiger Aero adds bright daylight nature imagery and humanist type to that surface. Leopard’s aurora picture shows the two converging by 2007.
borrow: Use a floor reflection under a row of icons to suggest a glass shelf.
Give small status buttons a gel look: saturated color, a white highlight, and a dark rim.

rights.statement: Apple software; copyrighted. No image is stored here.
